app.title: WorkFlowSync
tasks.title: Sync Tasks
tasks.empty: No tasks configured yet. Click 'Add task' to get started.
tasks.delete_message: Delete task '{0}'? Existing files on your disk will not be touched.
log.title: Event Log
settings.title: Settings
settings.startup_hint: Runs minimized in the taskbar notification area and checks folders in the background.
settings.task_hint: Runs the console utility in the background without opening a window.
settings.language_hint: Language changes take effect immediately across all windows.
settings.theme_hint: 'Follow Windows' switches automatically with your system appearance.
settings.scanner_hint: Larger buffer cuts down network round-trips over SMB shares (default 256 KB). Parallelism 8–16 is ideal for local networks.
settings.app_files_desc: All settings, state database (state.db), and logs are stored inside the application directory. You can easily move the entire folder anywhere.
settings.log_keep_hint: Older logs are removed automatically during subsequent checks.
pair.mode_mirror_hint: Source remains unchanged. New files are moved to destination folder. Files added, modified or deleted in destination folder are not re-synced (remain in destination folder).
pair.watch_auto_hint: Reacts instantly to filesystem events when supported by the storage.
pair.cloud_files_hint_mirror: Not applicable to this task: the source is a network share, while cloud placeholders only exist on local drives.
pair.transfer_checkbox: only files added in the last
pair.transfer_hint: Older files are not synced and remain in the first folder only.
pair.autoclean_checkbox: automatically delete items synced longer than
pair.autoclean_hint: Files synced prior to this period are moved from the second folder to Recycle Bin and no longer synced.
pair.approval_checkbox: review changes in the second folder
pair.approval_hint: Changes are not synced automatically: the application displays them in a list and awaits your decision.
pair.versioning_checkbox: keep copies of deleted and modified files
pair.excludes_hint: One pattern per line, relative to the root. Examples: \Temp · *.tmp · \Project\*Draft.docx
approval.title: Review Changes
approval.approve_all_tip: Apply all pending changes to the first folder as well
approval.dismiss_all_tip: Keep differences as they are; do not ask again
approval.revert_all_tip: Restore the second folder back to match the first folder for all items
approval.search_watermark: Search by file name or path...
approval.ceiling_warning: Warning! Over 100 pending changes queued. This may indicate an unintended move or directory change. Please review carefully before applying.
approval.approve_item_tip: Approve — sync change to first folder
approval.revert_item_tip: Revert — restore original file from first folder
recent.title: Recent Changes
recent.empty: Files copied into your folders will appear here.
recent.reveal_tip: Open folder in Explorer and select file
tray.minimized_hint: The app minimized to the system tray. Use the tray icon near the clock to open, sync, or exit.
hint.cpuload.full: Runs as many parallel directory scans as configured below at normal priority. Fastest, but can impact responsiveness on slower PCs.
hint.cpuload.low: Two directory scans with lowest thread priority. Sync takes longer, but keeps your PC responsive.
hint.cpuload.balanced: Uses up to half of available CPU cores with reduced thread priority. Fast sync while keeping the system responsive.
hint.notify.off: No pop-up notifications will be shown. Events remain visible in the recent changes window and log.
hint.notify.errors: No alerts for newly added files; only warnings and errors are shown.
hint.notify.all: A single summarized notification per pass. Clicking it opens the list of changed files.
hint.notify.quiet: Between {0:00}:00 and {1:00}:00 routine notifications are muted, while errors are always delivered.
pair.toggle_tip_pause: Pause automatic check for this task
pair.cloud_not_applicable_mirror: Not applicable to this task: the source is a network share, while cloud placeholders are on the local disk.
pair.cloud_not_applicable_twoway: Not applicable to this task: neither folder is on a local drive.
tasks.subtitle: Manage and monitor your folder synchronization
